said.q: an early abstract study demonstrates the manner in which area, depth, and brushwork are used in the complex later work…Space is induced by overlapping and enhanced by the dark diagonal line (freely ruled in the manner of a sign painter) which, moving from the upper left corner toward the bottom and right of the canvas, begins a background line but ends as part of the foreground…Such an over-and-under process evolves shape, area, and color relations naturally, and heightens the foreground-background tension
said.in: Abstract Painting in America, Cambridge 1983, p. 18

acts.cite: Remarking upon the limited series, Seitz eloquently notes, “Not drawings in the traditional sense, they are instead rehearsals in paint” (Ibid., 20).
